newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Military Academy cadet accused of rape.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Military Academy cadet accused of rape.

text.p: A cadet at the U.S. Military Academy here has been accused of raping another cadet, the first such case since women were admitted to the prestigious school, authorities said on Thursday.

Cadet James Engelbrecht, 22, is charged with raping a female cadet over the Memorial Day holiday weekend in May at the home of another cadet in Stockholm, New Jersey, West Point authorities said. He also faces a charge of committing an indecent act.
Engelbrecht, a senior from Conroe, Texas, continues to attend classes, authorities said. No details of the incident or the name of the victim were released.
No trial date has been set. Engelbrecht may request a trial by jury or a by a military judge. If found guilty, he faces the possibility of a life sentence in a military prison.

The case is the first time one cadet has been accused of raping another since women first began attending the military academy in 1976, West Point spokeswoman Andrea Hamburger said. But she said a cadet was accused of raping a civilian in 1976.
West Point, about 50 miles (80 km) north of New York City, has 3,468 male cadets and 525 female cadets.
